autoUpdateResult.successDescription: The automatic server update completed successfully.
autoUpdateResult.successDescriptionVersioned: The automatic server update completed successfully (now running {{version}}).

reasons.MANAGED_CONTAINER: This server runs in a panel-managed Docker container. Update the container image instead — the panel does not run SteamCMD against a managed container.
reasons.NOT_CONFIGURED: The SteamCMD path or server install path is not configured.
reasons.INITIAL_SCAN_FAILED: Could not verify whether the server was running, so the update was abandoned for safety.
reasons.RCON_NOT_CONNECTED: RCON was not connected, so the server could not be stopped safely.
reasons.SAVE_FAILED: The world could not be saved ({{reason}}), so the update was abandoned rather than lose progress.
reasons.STOP_SCAN_FAILED: Lost the ability to verify the server had stopped, so the update was abandoned for safety.
reasons.STOP_TIMEOUT: The server did not stop within 5 minutes.
reasons.STEAM_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS: A Steam install or update was already in progress for {{path}}, so the automatic update was abandoned to avoid racing it.
reasons.UNKNOWN: An unexpected error occurred during the automatic update.

stopServer.title: Stop server
stopServer.description: Are you sure you want to stop the server? All connected players will be disconnected.

forceStopServer.title: Force stop server
forceStopServer.description: This attempts a quick save (up to 3 seconds), then stops the game immediately whether or not the save succeeds.

restartServer.title: Restart server
restartServer.description: This will send a 5-minute warning to all players, then restart the server.

restartServerNow.title: Restart server now
restartServerNow.description: This will immediately restart the server without warning.

stopServerRequested.title: Shutdown requested
stopServerRequested.description: The server is saving and closing gracefully — this can take a moment on a large world. The status badge will update once it's confirmed stopped.

forceStopServer.title: Server force stopped
forceStopServer.description: The world was saved, then the game process was stopped.

forceStopSaveFailed.title: Server force stopped — save failed
forceStopSaveFailed.description: The pre-stop save was refused. Recent progress may be lost.

forceStopSaveTimedOut.title: Server force stopped — save timed out
forceStopSaveTimedOut.description: The pre-stop save didn't respond within 3 seconds. Recent progress may be lost.

forceStopSaveSkipped.title: Server force stopped — no save attempted
forceStopSaveSkipped.description: RCON wasn't connected, so no save was attempted before stopping. Recent progress may be lost.

verdict.rconHelpTip: RCON is the remote-console protocol this panel uses to send commands to the running game — kicking players, saving the world, broadcasting messages, and everything else the panel does. While it's disconnected, those actions are unavailable until it reconnects.

wipeDialog.title: Wipe server
wipeDialog.description: Select what data to delete from {{serverName}}. The server must be stopped.

map.label: Map & terrain
map.desc: Chunks, terrain, buildings, zombie population, iso regions.

players.label: Players & vehicles
players.desc: Player saves, inventories, positions, vehicle data.

world.label: World state
world.desc: World dictionary, metadata, erosion, game object states, radio.

accounts.label: Accounts & bans
accounts.desc: User accounts, passwords, roles, whitelist and ban lists. Everyone re-registers on next join.

wipeDialog.notice: Selecting map, players or world permanently deletes that data — there is no undo unless you back it up first below. Selecting accounts permanently deletes the whitelist and ban lists; everyone re-registers on next join. Server .ini and sandbox settings are stored separately and will not be affected.
wipeDialog.backupDesc: Creates a full backup of the current save (and the accounts database, if selected) before anything is deleted. Restore it from the Backups page.
wipeDialog.noBackupDesc: Whatever you wipe is gone permanently, with no way to undo it through the panel.
wipeDialog.noFilesFound: No files found for the selected targets.
wipeDialog.truncatedWarning: The scan stopped early on a very large save — these counts are a minimum, the real numbers may be higher.
